confidence_notes: Food anchors are supported by a recent city-level cost-of-living aggregate. Cocktail and wine estimates use local price ranges relative to the draft-beer anchor and are less certain. Accommodation is a holistic estimate; room prices vary substantially by season and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bratislava is treated as a mid-priced Central European capital; food and drink use Bratislava-specific benchmarks, while lodging uses broad estimates for the city’s hostel and hotel market.
